name: Hong Kong — Kam Tin Driving Test
description: 3.445 km Kam Tin solo driving test, v0.4 visual repair. Raised generic photomesh and source vegetation replaced by authored trees at inferred canopy locations. Retained individualised buildings and infrastructure. Matte road and track materials, explicit zero emissive. Temporary road/profile and barriers; eight blue test markers. Practice, one car, clear daytime. User confirmed v0.3 loading/driving; v0.4 appearance and FPS need a fresh user test.
